# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) ## ESP32 Closed-Loop Motor Controller & Motion Subsystem **Subsystem**: Lithography & Metrology Stage Electronics **Action Classification**: 🛒 BUY (COTS Qualified Component) **Target Processor**: ESP32-WROOM-32D (Dual-Core 240MHz Xtensa, 520KB SRAM, 4MB Flash) **Actuation Mode**: Closed-Loop Hardware Quadrature Decoding ($4\times$ PCNT) with PID Feedback --- ### 1. Hardware Pinout & Closed-Loop Architecture Schematic ```text ESP32 Closed-Loop System Block Diagram ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ ESP32-WROOM-32D Core Controller │ │ │ │ [ Core 0: Comm & Telemetry ] [ Core 1: 1kHz PID Loop ] │ │ - I2C OLED Display (GPIO 21/22) - PCNT Quad Decode (34/35) │ │ - UART Host Link (GPIO 1/3) - MCPWM Motor Drive (18/19) │ │ - E-Stop Interrupt (GPIO 4) - Limit Sw Input (GPIO 25/26)│ └────────┬──────────────────────┬──────────────────────┬─────────────────┘ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ ┌──────────────┐ ┌─────────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │ I2C Display │ │ Optocoupled │ │ Optical │ │ SSD1306 OLED │ │ Gate Driver │ │ Encoder │ │ (Status Mon) │ │ (TMC2209/DRV) │ │ (HEDS-9700) │ └──────────────┘ └────────┬────────┘ └──────▲───────┘ │ │ ▼ │ ┌─────────────────┐ │ │ NEMA 17 Stepper │─────────────┘ │ (0.9 deg, 400s) │ (Mechanical Coupling) └─────────────────┘ ``` #### Inline Technical SVG Pinout & Wiring Diagram:
![ESP32 Official DevKit Pinout Reference](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/02/ESP32_Pinout.png/640px-ESP32_Pinout.png) --- ### 2. Hardware Bill of Materials (BOM) & Reagent Specs | Component Class | Part Number / Model | Supplier / Vendor | Key Specification | Cost (USD) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Microcontroller** | ESP32-WROOM-32D | Espressif Systems / DigiKey | 240MHz Xtensa LX6, 4MB Flash | $3.80 | | **Motor Gate Driver** | TMC2209 SilentStepStick | Trinamic / Watterott | 2.0A RMS, 256 microstepping, UART | $9.50 | | **Optical Encoder** | Broadcom HEDS-9700-E50 | Broadcom / Mouser | 500 LPI differential quadrature | $18.20 | | **Position Scale** | Linear Glass Scale ($100\text{ mm}$) | Ditron / AliExpress | $1.0\,\mu\text{m}$ grating resolution | $45.00 | | **Isolated DC Supply** | MeanWell LRS-75-24 | Mean Well / DigiKey | 24V DC @ 3.2A, Low Ripple $< 120\text{ mV}$ | $16.50 | --- ### 3. Step-by-Step COTS Qualification & Commissioning Protocol 1. **Hardware Power-On & Voltage Rail Verification**: - Apply $24.0\text{ V}$ DC from isolated linear power supply to motor driver rail. - Measure $3.30\text{ V} \pm 0.05\text{ V}$ rail on ESP32 3V3 pin with digital multimeter. 2. **Quadrature Pulse Counter (PCNT) Unit Calibration**: - Connect encoder Channel A to GPIO34, Channel B to GPIO35. - Configure ESP32 hardware **PCNT** unit in $4\times$ quadrature counting mode: ```c pcnt_config_t pcnt_config = { .pulse_gpio_num = 34, .ctrl_gpio_num = 35, .channel = PCNT_CHANNEL_0, .unit = PCNT_UNIT_0, .pos_mode = PCNT_COUNT_INC, .neg_mode = PCNT_COUNT_DEC, .lctrl_mode = PCNT_MODE_REVERSE, .hctrl_mode = PCNT_MODE_KEEP, .counter_h_lim = 32767, .counter_l_lim = -32768 }; ``` - Rotate motor shaft by hand exactly 1 turn; confirm register reads $2000 \pm 2$ counts ($500 \times 4$). 3. **1 kHz High-Priority FreeRTOS PID Loop Task**: - Pin dedicated PID control loop to **Core 1** running at strictly $1000\text{ Hz}$ ($1.0\text{ ms} \pm 20\,\mu\text{s}$). - Execute positional control algorithm: $$u(t) = K_p \cdot e(t) + K_i \sum e(t) \Delta t + K_d \frac{e(t) - e(t - \Delta t)}{\Delta t}$$ - Anti-windup threshold clamping at $[\pm 100\%]$ PWM duty cycle. 4. **Safety E-Stop Verification**: - Assert hardware emergency stop push-button (GPIO4 pulled LOW). - Verify motor driver `EN` pin disables within $< 250\,\mu\text{s}$, dumping inductive current to ground.
